mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (20-year median), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering corporate revenue revisions downward and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1.0% MoM, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production during supply shock regimes reduces manufacturing output and increases input costs, compressing corporate margins and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by >0.5% MoM during supply shocks, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS > 150k) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and quarterly GDP growth signal severe economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines >0.5% MoM and GDPC1 declines >0.2% QoQ, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates during monetary tightening cycles compress equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.
